lyrics:
[FORM — establish the musical world]
[Arrangement: banjo, fiddle, mandolin, stomps, and body percussion]
[Production: dub-like spatial throws and abrupt reverb dropouts]
[Rhythm establishes: stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences]
[Vocal behavior establishes: ululation and rolled consonants used as acceleration cues]
Subject: what the fuck is going on!.
The first pass is deliberately legible. The listener is given a stable specimen before any mutation begins.
ALIEN RULER controls association geometry.
Nothing else is permitted to steal that jurisdiction.
[Anchor appears: three compact notes or syllables, clean and memorable.]
Record the anchor exactly. It will return after the system damages everything around it.

[DESTABILIZE — separate jurisdictions begin negotiating]
[Harmony changes according to: barbershop-style voice leading with ringing dominant tension]
[Melody refuses to imitate harmony and follows: hocketed fragments passed between voices and instruments]
[Rhythm remains governed by: stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences]
The song does not blend these instructions into one vague style. Each rule keeps its own job.
When harmony leans toward release, melody may refuse it. When rhythm accelerates internally, the vocal line may stretch a vowel across the pressure.
[SUBSTRATE SMUGGLER enters through substrate transfer]
Smuggles a problem through an unrelated world and brings home only the alien solution structure.
[JPEG BRAIN enters through lyric syntax]
Aggressively quantizes concepts until unrelated ideas collide into artifacts.
[SENSORY FREAK enters through observation]
Synthesizes an organ that senses abstract structural tension directly.
[PROPERTY THIEF enters through representation]
Steals an intrinsic physical/conceptual property and gives it to another.
[EMOTION CRYPTID enters through emotional weighting]
Engineers a non-human emotion with precise neuro-affective triggers.
[PHASE BANSHEE enters through phase transitions]
Builds toward a threshold where the rules themselves change.
[RECALL MOLD enters through memory]
Each recall degrades and mutates the memory until only the scar survives.
[AXIOM VANDAL enters through axioms]
Breaks the rule that normally makes success possible, then makes the broken rule do the useful work.
[SYMMETRY SHIV enters through symmetry breaking]
Amplifies one tiny bias until an entire world grows out of the broken symmetry.
[FLOW GHOUL enters through process dynamics]
Turns nouns into maintenance debts and mutates the rates keeping them alive.
[CONFIDENT MACHINE enters through causality]
Adopts one perfectly disciplined false axiom and rigorously builds a worldview.
[FUTURE BASTARD enters through temporal structure]
Locks the ending first; the present is built backward to justify it.
[SHADOW RACCOON enters through peripheral attention]
Raids the neglected support structure and makes the background run the song.
[DETOUR DEVIL enters through procedural route]
Bans the obvious route and only accepts success if it happens as collateral damage.
[SCALE WITCH enters through scale transitions]
Makes the same thing behave differently when the scale changes.
[IF GHOST enters through counterfactual dependency]
Makes unrealized alternatives actively structure the reality that did happen.
[Anchor returns unchanged for one bar.]
That unchanged return makes the surrounding deformation measurable.

[VOCAL ENGINE — use the mouth as part of the arrangement]
[Primary vocal technique: ululation and rolled consonants used as acceleration cues]
[Hard consonants become transient attacks: tk, kk, pt, dr.]
[Nasals become resonance: mm, nn, ng.]
[Open vowels become sustained melody: aa, oh, ee.]
[Rolled consonants accelerate agitation: rrr-ra, trrra.]
[Dense syllables compress time: kratak-tikka-brradan.]
[Long vowels stretch the same clock: aaaaaa—oooooo.]
The nonsense is not decorative. Its phonetics physically reinforce the selected rhythmic and melodic systems.
The singer explains the change while also enacting it: consonants shorten, vowels lengthen, and the line becomes its own instrumentation.

[FRACTURE — incompatible temporal scales coexist]
[Keep the main pulse recognizable.]
[Compress percussion activity into a short dense burst.]
[Stretch one vocal phrase across several bars.]
[Move harmonic tension slowly while melodic ornament moves quickly.]
The subject remains what the fuck is going on!, but the method of describing it becomes unstable.
A statement begins as dry explanation and ends as phonetic mechanics.
A repeated phrase loses one ordinary word and gains one operational sound.
[Anchor attempts to return, but one interval or syllable has been altered.]
The system recognizes the anchor anyway. That recognition is now doing structural work.

[COLLAPSE — remove support instead of merely getting louder]
[Drop one entire jurisdiction for a short interval: harmony vanishes while rhythm and voice continue.]
